[LHYD.8.1] Hydration calls accept an optional `filter:` kwarg — a
boolean expression the adapter applies at query time,
before asserting facts. Reduces wire traffic and
hydrated-fact count.

The storage library's hydration services declare no `filter_fields`
([LSTO.13.1]), so a `filter:` on them is a compile error ([LHYD.8.3.5]): the
store cannot see inside a record ([LSTO.2.1]), and rules filter the hydrated
facts as they match them.
